item.title: Image Problem

semiShigUre, a member of Japanese Branch, has identified the source of the image. It seems to be an art piece of Japanese artist Hirotoshi Ito, titled as "口の堅い奴ら(The Closelipped Guys)".

http://scrap.jiyuseki.com/

This link leads to his blog "Jiyuseki Zakki". I recommend to contact him and get the proper permission.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
burst out laughing and instinctively upvoted on the picture alone

Queries:

- What about people like me who don't require subliminal thrumming to convince to feed the rocks and possibly some form of sedation to keep from laughing every time it opens its mouth?

- Resort to any means to feed it, including killing pets(?!) and murder(…?). Unless this thing was discovered in the Steppes of East Asia, why the shit is this necessary? Can't the affected person just buy meat from a supermarket? Or is it so insanely picky about "fresh" meat that it refuses anything exposed to air longer than 6 seconds?

- Exactly what sort and/or strength of "compulsion" do these things have? Like, what happens if they don't get fed? Couldn't the owner just shut them up and put them in a locked box instead of going through the immensely more tedious and complicated process of stalking, confronting and potentially fighting someone, killing them, and cutting them up to feed these ungrateful rocks?
